rlz0SourceCSID is a string property which represents the clone_stable_id of the source BOM line. rlz0SourceCSID is used for comparing the CSID path of the source structure and the CSID path of the target structure. rlz0SourceCSID adds the support to identify the structural changes of the source structure to the realized target structure. NULL value is allowed for rlz0SourceCSID. In the case of normal 4GD realization, this property is populated with NULL values.

rlz0CSIDInParent is a Rlz0RealizationMap type object which will hold the information of the realization map instance of the immediate parent of the 4GD object. rlz0CSIDInParent provides the information of the parent 4G object which is used to calculate the CSID of the target 4GD structure. rlz0CSIDInParent adds the support to identify the structural changes in the source and target structures and helps to resolve those changes. NULL value is allowed for rlz0CSIDInParent for the case of normal 4GD realization and for the first level 4GD structures which are directly under application model object in the case of smart discovery.

rlz0SourceObject is a POM_object type which holds the information of the source object for the corresponding target 4GD object after realization. rlz0SourceObject provides the information of the source structure information to identify the structural changes. rlz0SourceObject adds the support to identify the re-parent structural changes in the source and helps to resolve those changes in the target structure by modifying the memberships objects. NULL value is allowed for rlz0SourceObject and this property is always NULL for normal 4GD realization.

TcRuntimeType.description: Rlz0RefCompositionProvider is internal business Object supported for only Active Workspace. This object is used by Active Workspace framework to fetch the data as per search criteria.This business object is act as data provider that returns compositions that reference the source object, source object will be ItemThis business object is used for 4th Generation Designer Active workspace.

Rlz0SourceObjectRefByProvider is internal business Object supported for only Active Workspace. This object is used by Active Workspace framework to fetch the data as per search criteria.This business object is act as data provider that returns all realized items which are using the same source object as input realized item.This business object is used for 4th Generation Designer Active workspace.

TcStandardType.description: Rlz0Composition is an abstract business object composed of Rlz0Subset business objects that bring together model element content from the same or different application model.Rlz0Composition-Rlz0Subset data model is similar to Cpd0Workset-Cpd0DesignSubsetElement data model except Rlz0Composition can be part of a target application model and hence can be part of a certain context. Sparse Realization only creates references to the source model element and hence is a lightweight mode of realization. Each Rlz0Subset business object can bring in content from one source application model which can be different for each Rlz0Subset business object.Unlike the Cpd0Workset the Rlz0Composition is a POM_revisable business object and can be part of minor revision configuration.Unlike the Cpd0DesignSubsetElement the Rlz0Subset is not a conditional element and hence cannot be configurable. It is POM_revisable and can be part of minor revision configuration. The Rlz0Composition data model is available in the realization layer which can be utilized by other downstream applications based out of the Realization template.This business object is used by 4th Generation Design and its downstream application such as NGP, P&ID, MDConnectivity etc.Downstream Applications and customers should subtype this business object to utilize the sparse realization functionality.

TcProperty.description: A runtime property that refers to the associated Rlz0Subset objects. NULL if no Subsets associated.

TcStandardType.description: Rlz0GDEArtifact is a concrete subclass of Model Artifact to support realization for General Design Component (GDE) objects.GDE is a lightweight non-revisable object whose types can be used to model a connectible interface of a product, for example, a parallel port on a computer. In electromechanical product representations, GDEs are used to model ports, interfaces, terminals or process variables associated with a signal. Rlz0GDEArtifact business object is used to manifest such model contents.This business object is utilized by P & ID application and it can be subtyped further.

Rlz0ItemInstance business object represents a Realization Object used for Two Dimensional item to model realization.This business object is used to represent the subordinate objects realized in the application model.This business object is an internal object which is created while performing create item realization operation. It references to the rlz0ReuseElement object that holds the realized contents.This business object is utilized by the P & ID application and it can be further subtyped. However, it is typically not expected to subtype this class by an external customer.

Rlz0ItemRealization is an abstract subclass of Rlz0Realization business object.It contains item configuration statements needed to specify how a source item should be configured prior to being realized. In order to make sure variant expressions on the source in a Product are valid for the objects created in the target application model, product information must be recorded. The same product information will be used during update.Every application will have a different way to process item structure and render realized content into the target model. Therefore, applications will need to extend this class and add their specific processing and behaviors.

TcProperty.description: This runtime property represents the source input for item realization. The supported input business object types are Item, ItemRevision, PSBomView, PSBomViewRevision and BOMLine.

TcStandardType.description: The Rlz0ItemRealizationMap is a Business Object used internally during Item Realization to maintain a link between the source item Business Object and the target Model Element Business Object.Rlz0ItemRealizationMap automatically gets created in the background when any application realizes a source Item Assembly into a target Application Model.When Users select and update a target Model Element the ItemRealizationMap Business Object is used internally to identify the Source Object based on which the update will be performed.Rlz0ItemRealizationMap is available for 4GD (4th Generation Foundation) based applications.Since the ItemRealizationMap Business Object is an internal Business Object the customer would not be customizing the Business Object attributes and type of the ItemRealizationMap Business Object.However, internal downstream applications could potentially sub-type and/or add custom attributes to the ItemRealizationMap Business Object provided they are adding a new flavor of Item Realization specific to the downstream application's functional needs.

Rlz0M2MSubsetInstantiation manages the realization of Application Model (Mdl0ApplicationModel) content into another Application Model.This is an internal class which is created when performing M2M Instantiation. It references the Reuse object which is created for holding the instantiated contents. Rlz0M2MSubsetInstantiation also holds the search recipe that needed to provide search criteria for including contents from the source application model.This is used by 4th Generation Design and its downstream applications. Internal applications can subtype this class to overwrite any behavior. It's typically not expected to subtype this class by external customer.

Rlz0M2MSubsetRealization manages the Model To Model realization of application model content into another application model.This is an internal object which is created when performing Model To Model realization. It references to the Rlz0RealizationContainer object that holds realized contents. This also holds the search recipe that is needed to provide search criteria for including content from the source application model.This is used by 4th Generation Design and its downstream applications. Internal applications can subtype this class to override any behavior. It's typically not expected to subtype this class by external customer.

Rlz0ModelRealization is an Abstract type that contains the behavior to manage the realization of Application Model (Mdl0ApplicationModel) content into another Application Model.Rlz0ModelRealization holds information necessary for realization like configuration data, search criteria, container, source model and target model for realization.Applications subtype this class when further specific types of model realization are needed.Rlz0ModelRealization business object is used by 4Th Generation Design and its downstream applications.

TcProperty.description: The source model object, configured using the recipe cparam.

TcStandardType.description: Rlz0ModelRealizationMap business object represents an element realized from a source application model (Mdl0ApplicationModel). Rlz0ModelRealizationMaps are automatically created or deleted in the background when a cross-application-model realization or instantiation is created or updated.When a user performs update realization on Rlz0Subset object that gets created on realization, Rlz0ModelRealizationMap object is used internally to identify the source object based on which the update is performed. This business object is created during create or update sparse realization activity. It is deleted if the sparse elements are to be removed as part of update realization.This is used by 4th Generation Design and its downstream applications.Internal applications can subtype this class to override any behavior. It's typically not expected to subtype this class by external customer.

Rlz0PopulateInstantiation is a realization object which is used for item to model realization for the 4GD smart discovery functionality. Rlz0PopulateInstantiation is used for realization of organizational items and non installation assemblies to partitions and reuse design elements of the 4GD application model. Rlz0PopulateInstantiation adds the support for item to partition realization. Rlz0PopulateInstantiation is used in Teamcenter for smart discovery functionality in 4GD application.

Rlz0Realization business object contains information about the source and the target model along with the recipe and configuration context information that was used to identify the configured content to be realized. This is used by 4th Generation Design and its downstream applications.It is an abstract business object. Internal applications can subtype this class to override any behavior. It's typically not expected to subtype this class by external customer.

Rlz0RealizationContainer business object is a reflection of the application model being realized into the target model.This business object is used to manage the realized content from one application model to other application model. Two types of model to model realization operations create and update utilize the instances of this business object.For each realization, a new instance of this business object is created to collect the realized content in the target model. Internally each realization will remember the search criteria or the configuration criteria that was used on the source model to collect a set of objects to be realized into the target model. The newly created objects in the target model are fully populated meaning they are created in persistent or static fashion.This business object can be subtyped further.

TcProperty.description: Refers to the realization subset object (of type Rlz0M2MSubsetRealization), associated with realization maps which contains the realized content. The realization information during create or update operations like search criteria or configuration context is persisted on the realization subset object referred by this property.This property value cannot be NULL as there is a one-to-one between realization container and the realization subset object.

TcStandardType.description: Rlz0RealizationMap is an abstract class business object used internally by various sub-types to maintain a link between a source business object and a corresponding target business object in various types of realizations (Rlz0Realization sub-types).Instances of Rlz0RealizationMap cannot be created, as it's an abstract class.Rlz0RealizationMap is available for 4GD Application.Since the Rlz0RealizationMap Business Object is an abstract internal Business Object the customer would not be customizing the Business Object attributes.Internal downstream application could potentially sub typed it for different realization processes. It's not recommended to subtype this class by external customer.

Rlz0RealizedItem business object represents the two dimensional item realized through an item to model realization.This business object is used to support the realization of non-3D objects in the context of an application model.This business object is utilized by P & ID applications, other applications can further subtype.

Rlz0Subset business object is used to manage sparsely realized model content into a target Application model.Rlz0Subset is a container object to Model Elements created in a target Application Model. Rlz0Subset is created directly under a Composition business object during sparse realization create operation. Sparse realization can be done with a Subset Definition Recipe from whose execution the Rlz0Subset's content is populated or by an explicit list of Model Elements.Rlz0Subset is used in 4th Generation Designer, Manufacturing and downstream applications. It can be extended by internal downstream or external customer applications.

TcProperty.description: This property stores reference to a Subset instance object. This Property holds object Reference type.During the sparse realization, Subset Instance business Object is created to preserve the state of sparse realization, such as the Revision Rule and Configuration Context.

TcStandardType.description: Rlz0SubsetInstance manages the realization of Application Model (Mdl0ApplicationModel) content into another Application Model.This is an internal class which is created when performing sparse realization. It holds the Subset (RlzSubset) as owning object which is created for holding the realized contents. Rlz0SubsetInstance also holds the search recipe that is needed to provide search criteria for including contents from the source application model.This is used by 4th Generation Design and its downstream applications.Internal applications can subtype this class to overwrite any behavior. It's typically not expected to subtype this class by external customer.

ServiceInterface.description:
This service provides operations that enable copying of model content from one application model (Mdl0ApplicationModel) into another application model in a static fashion, i.e. new objects are always created in the target model.

Model Elements within the source application model must be subtypes of Positioned model element (Mdl0PositionedModelElement).

Currently two operations are provided by this service namely createOrUpdateModelToModelRealization and getSourceModelConfigInfo.

Realization between application models is a process of allowing model content from one application model to be copied into another application model. All or a portion of the source model can be realized into the target model. Associations are maintained between related objects in the source and target models, allowing for update of the target. The category of the realized model elements in the target model is always Subordinate. Principal use case for realization is MBOM.


Use case:

createOrUpdateModelToModelRealization:
This SOA operation provides a service to Realize one Application Model (objects) to another Application Model. This SOA can be used for Realization and update Realized objects. For Realization the user will provide source information and get list of objects that has been newly created at target Application objects along with realization container objects. For update of realized objects the user should provide container object and source object and will get list of objects updated, deleted and created during update.
Note: Please see operation Use case section for more details.

getSourceModelConfigInfo:
This operation gets the configuration information of the source model element that was used during realization or instantiation. The input objects could be any of Reuse Design Component,
Subordinate of a Reuse Design Component, Realization container object or Realized content
The operation returns the list of source model object configuration information as a response or fails in case of error condition.
Note: Please see operation Use case section for more details.

getSourceItemConfigInfo:
This operation gets configuration information used to configure a source item assembly for realization. This is useful for application that need to expand the underlying item assembly structure in a manner consistent with its realized representation in the model.
Note: Please see operation Use case section for more details.
ServiceInterface.name: RealizationManagement

ServiceInterface.description:
Note: The operations in this service are not published ones and added for internal use only.

This service provides operations that enable searching the model elements (Mdl0ModelElement) in a given Composition (Rlz0Composition). Model elements returned are the sparse elements whose source elements could belong to different application models. An application model could be a product design (Cpd0CollaborativeDesign in the case of 4GD).

Use Cases:
The search service supports both spatial and non-spatial search capabilities by providing the appropriate search expressions.

Spatial:
    • Box Zone Expression (Mdl0SearchBoxZone) defines a rectangular (axis aligned) box, defined in a 3D space, which could be used to find Positioned Model Elements that are either inside/outside/intersecting the 3 dimensional box.
    • Plane Zone Expression (Mdl0SearchPlaneZone) defines a 3D plane and the search expression could define to look for Positioned Model Elements above/below/intersecting the plane.
    • Proximity Expression (Mdl0SearchProximity) used to find Positioned Model Elements that are spatially nearby a given set of other Positioned Model Elements.


Non Spatial:
    • Saved Query Expression (Mdl0SearchSavedQuery) used to search Positioned Model Elements with specific property values. Accepts wildcards for property values.
    • Include Expression (Mdl0SearchSlctContent) specific set of Model Elements that are included as part of the search result.
    • Exclude Expression (Mdl0SearchGroup) specific set of Model Elements that are excluded from the search result.
    • Closure Query Expression (Mdl0SearchOptionSet) Return related objects, selected by the given option set and closure rule, as part of the search results.


The above search expressions could be joined using AND/OR operators to form complex Search Recipes. The results of a search execution could be sorted using one or more of the properties of the returned object type. The parameter defaultLoadCount specified in the SearchOptions is kept for future support and presently will be considered 0 (zero) internally even if some value is populated.

A set of name value pairs (string, string) used to specify additional property data or specify sync flags. All values are specified as strings, the caller is responsible for generating the correct string representation of each name and value passed. This is an optional argument.
Supported value pairs are:
1. Key: "append"
Valid values: "true" or "false"
Default value: "false"
If append flag is true, appends the content (valid content objects are Mdl0ModelElement, Mdl0SubsetDefinition and Ptn0Partition) to Rlz0Subset without replacing or removing the existing realized content. If false, regular update happens.

2. Key: "SMART_UPDATE"
Valid values: "true" or "false"
Default value: "false"
If this flag is true, new revisions of sparse content are identified, which would be appended to the Rlz0Subset object and the old sparse revisions will be marked as inactive. If false, regular update happens.
Note: The "append" and "SMART_UPDATE" flags are mutually exclusive.

3. Key: "CARRYOVER"
Valid values: "true" or "false"
Default value: "false"
If this flag is true, attached relations to the existing revisions of sparse elements are carried over to the new revisions of sparse elements. If false, attached relations to existing revisions are not carried forward.

4. Key: "includeSourceObjectForSubsets"
Valid values: "true" or "false"
Default value: "false"
If this flag is true, source objects are returned without encoded in-context data. If false, source objects are returned with encoded in-context data.

OperationTemplate.description:
Note: This operation is not a published one and added for internal use only.

This operation executes a search in Composition (Rlz0Composition). Composition can have multiple subsets (Rlz0Subset) which are the holders for model realization content and also store the information about the configuration parameters applied during the realization. For each realization instance, a different Subset gets created which contains realized model content from a specific application model. However, different Subsets can exist in a composition; and those subsets can have realized model content from different application models. This operation searches the content from all the subsets.

Search Recipe is constructed from appropriate search expressions which are combined from multiple simpler search expressions (both spatial and non-spatial) in a logical sequence.

Spatial:
    • Box Zone Expression (Mdl0SearchBoxZone) defines a rectangular (axis aligned) box, defined in a 3D space, which could be used to find Positioned Model Elements that are either inside/outside/intersecting the 3 dimensional box.
    • Plane Zone Expression (Mdl0SearchPlaneZone) defines a 3D plane and the search expression could define to look for Positioned Model Elements above/below/intersecting the plane.
    • Proximity Expression (Mdl0SearchProximity) used to find Positioned Model Elements that are spatially nearby a given set of other Positioned Model Elements.


Non Spatial:
    • Saved Query Expression (Mdl0SearchSavedQuery) used to search Positioned Model Elements with specific property values. Accepts wildcards for property values.
    • Include Expression (Mdl0SearchSlctContent) specific set of Model Elements that are included as part of the search result.
    • Exclude Expression (Mdl0SearchGroup) specific set of Model Elements that are excluded from the search result.
    • Closure Query Expression (Mdl0SearchOptionSet) Return related objects, selected by the given option set and closure rule, as part of the search results.


The above search expressions could be joined using AND/OR operators to form complex Search Recipes. The results of a search execution could be sorted using one or more of the properties of the returned object type.

The search result as a map of Rlz0Subset and a list of sparse model elements. The SearchResponse does not paginate the results. Results are returned all at once.

The following partial errors maybe returned:
    • 279003 Composition object not specified in the search scope object.
    • 278033 Invalid bounding box information for the Proximity target(s) specified in the search recipe object.
    • 278034 Invalid trushape information for the Proximity target(s) specified in the search recipe object.

OperationTemplate.description:
This operation creates or updates realization content from an application model ( referred as source model ) into another application model ( referred as target model ). For each realization create operation, a new realizationContainer is created, under which the target realized content resides. Internally each Realization will remember the search criteria and the configuration rules that were used on source model to collect a set of objects that are now being realized into the target model.

The newly created objects in the target model are fully populated meaning they are created in persistent or static fashion. The realized model elements in the target model will be of same type and category as the source model objects.
For example, if a Design Component (Cpd0DesignElement) of category Shape from a source model is realized into a target model, the object type and category of the newly created object in the target model will still be the same as the object in the source model.

In case the realization content (list of model elements or a subset definition object) is not provided for create operation, then an empty realizationContainer object is created and populated in the SOA response. This realizationContainer object can be updated later to get the realization content.

Note: Internally BMIDE deep copy rules are used to traverse and realize the source objects and its corresponding secondary objects. For any special behaviour on object traversal and action type existing deep copy rules can be updated or new deep copy rules can be created.

Pre-Conditions:
1) The source application model is with some pre-existing model content.
2) Target application model already exists.

Limitations:
1) Partitions (Ptn0Partition) are not supported/Realized using this operation.

Applications/Customers should use existing Partition Template Realization capability to realize partitions from one model to another.

Note: Internally BMIDE deep copy rules are used to traverse and realize the source objects and its corresponding secondary objects. For any special behaviour on object traversal and action type existing deep copy rules can be updated or new deep copy rules can be created.

Pre-Conditions:
1) The source application model is with some pre-existing model content.
2) Target application model already exists.

Limitations:
1) Partitions (Ptn0Partition) are not supported/Realized using this operation.

Applications/Customers should use existing Partition Template Realization capability to realize partitions from one model to another.

Operation.name: createOrUpdateModelToModelRealization
Operation.returnDescription:
A list of RealizeModelElementData structures, where each structure is in one to one correspondence with the input RealizeModelContentInfo with the clientID.
Each structure contains information about:
1. realizationContiner object, which is either created or updated, in the current operation.
2. source-to-target UID map for created or updated objects.
3. Error structure for the failed objects.

Also, created/updated objects will also be sent in the standard ServiceData lists of created and updated objects respectively as response.
Operation.useCase:
To realize model elements ( coming from a Product definition application model ) into the manufacturing application model and maintain associations between related objects in the source and target models for updating realized content. The cross domain realization or Model- Model Realization use case supports different aspects of the common content across different domain models. The most typical cross domain realization or Model- Model Realization use case supports assignment of model elements ( coming from a Product definition ) into the manufacturing model.

The basic idea is that the realized model elements draw on all information from the source model elements and then add additional or override information in the realized model context. In terms of maturity propagation, the expectation is that this is controlled and when the user makes a deliberate decision to move forward to a newer maturity status of is source model elements, he will also make a decision to update the realization on the realized model elements. This allows both domains to proceed on their own path but still be collaborative in nature.

Realizing a reuse design component, will realize all its chain of subordinate design components by default. This is controlled by a business object constant called RealizeReuseAndSubordinates. If the value of this constant is true, then reuse and its full chain of subordinates will be realized together, else reuse or the selected subordinate will be ignored. Similarly realizing a subordinate design component will realize its reuse design component and full chain of subordinates for that reuse design component by default. The same preference can be used to control this behaviour.

Delete on the realization container will delete the container and its content.

Operation.description:
Note: This operation is not a published one and added for internal use only.

This operation executes a search in Composition (Rlz0Composition). Composition can have multiple subsets (Rlz0Subset) which are the holders for model realization content and also store the information about the configuration parameters applied during the realization. For each realization instance, a different Subset gets created which contains realized model content from a specific application model. However, different Subsets can exist in a composition; and those subsets can have realized model content from different application models. This operation searches the content from all the subsets.

Search Recipe is constructed from appropriate search expressions which are combined from multiple simpler search expressions (both spatial and non-spatial) in a logical sequence.

Spatial:
    • Box Zone Expression (Mdl0SearchBoxZone) defines a rectangular (axis aligned) box, defined in a 3D space, which could be used to find Positioned Model Elements that are either inside/outside/intersecting the 3 dimensional box.
    • Plane Zone Expression (Mdl0SearchPlaneZone) defines a 3D plane and the search expression could define to look for Positioned Model Elements above/below/intersecting the plane.
    • Proximity Expression (Mdl0SearchProximity) used to find Positioned Model Elements that are spatially nearby a given set of other Positioned Model Elements.


Non Spatial:
    • Saved Query Expression (Mdl0SearchSavedQuery) used to search Positioned Model Elements with specific property values. Accepts wildcards for property values.
    • Include Expression (Mdl0SearchSlctContent) specific set of Model Elements that are included as part of the search result.
    • Exclude Expression (Mdl0SearchGroup) specific set of Model Elements that are excluded from the search result.
    • Closure Query Expression (Mdl0SearchOptionSet) Return related objects, selected by the given option set and closure rule, as part of the search results.


The above search expressions could be joined using AND/OR operators to form complex Search Recipes. The results of a search execution could be sorted using one or more of the properties of the returned object type.
Operation.name: executeSearchInComposition
Operation.returnDescription:
The search result as a map of Rlz0Subset and a list of sparse model elements. The SearchResponse does not paginate the results. Results are returned all at once.

The following partial errors maybe returned:
    • 279003 Composition object not specified in the search scope object.
    • 278033 Invalid bounding box information for the Proximity target(s) specified in the search recipe object.
    • 278034 Invalid trushape information for the Proximity target(s) specified in the search recipe object.

ParameterInfo.description: Search options for a given search (load count and sorting)
